Answer: B
Reason: The CT image (Figure 3) reveals a well-defined, homogeneous soft-tissue density mass in the right paratracheal region that abuts the trachea without causing significant compression or invasion, which is characteristic of a benign bronchogenic cyst. The chest X-ray (Figure 1) corresponds to this finding with a smooth right paratracheal opacity, lacking signs of malignancy like ill-defined margins or calcification.
